name: Sunnyside
one_liner: Sunnyside helps you drink more mindfully with a weekly drink plan, tracking by app or text message, and access to human coaches, without requiring sobriety.
best_for: People who want to cut back rather than quit
not_for: Anyone who may need medical help to stop drinking safely
People aiming for full sobriety who want a recovery program
short_description: Sunnyside helps you drink more mindfully with a weekly drink plan, tracking by app or text message, and access to human coaches, without requiring sobriety.
long_description: Sunnyside helps you drink more mindfully with a weekly drink plan, tracking by app or text message, and access to human coaches, without requiring sobriety. Answer a short survey, get a weekly plan, and log drinks by text or in the app. Daily tips and text access to a coach keep you on track. Designed for moderation rather than quitting. What it includes: Weekly drink plans; Tracking by app or text; Coach messaging; Community; Progress dashboard.

faqs.a: 15-day trial, then about $99.99/year. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Sunnyside before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Sunnyside replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Sunnyside is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
Sunnyside is available on iPhone and Android.
